name: Natural Earth Shaded Relief Basic
versionNote: The official page advertises 3.2.0; the downloaded archive contains a VERSION file identifying 2.0.0.

georeferencing.textureUv: u=(longitude+180)/360; v=(90-latitude)/180; top row is v=0

dataMeaning: Grayscale shaded relief derived from downsampled SRTM Plus elevation data; land shading with flat gray water. This is baked shading, not an elevation or displacement map.

steps: Preserve the complete source raster extent and orientation without cropping, rotation, flipping, or generated terrain.
Encode as single-channel 8-bit grayscale JPEG with quality 75.
processing.command: sips --resampleHeightWidth 1024 2048 -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 75 SR_50M.tif --out relief.jpg
